description: REPLACE the organization's full set of custom label definitions, including each label's auto_extract and public-report visibility. The API replaces the list (no merge); read the current list with `list_account_labels` first. Returns the persisted list with allocated positions.

labels.description: REPLACEMENT list of all labels — pass every label you want to keep. Order in the array becomes `position`. Empty array removes all labels.

auto_extract.description: When true, the LLM auto-populates this label's value during scan classification. Defaults to false.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI.

key.description: Stable snake_case identifier used in scan filters.

show_in_public_report.description: When true, this label's value appears on unauthenticated public scan reports under its display_name. REPLACED like every other field: omitting it sets false, so pass the current value from `list_account_labels` to keep it.

name: update_account_labels
title: Update Account Labels
